main.description: A podcast feed/show. Record key is the podcast's Podcasting 2.0 UUIDv5 GUID, enabling direct lookup from RSS feed metadata.

artwork.description: Cover artwork for the podcast. Recommended: 1400x1400 to 3000x3000 pixels, square, no alpha channel.

createdAt.description: When the podcast record was created.

explicit.description: Whether the podcast contains explicit content. Defaults to false.

feedUrl.description: URL of the podcast's RSS feed.

guid.description: Podcasting 2.0 UUIDv5 GUID of the podcast. Must match the record key.

language.description: Primary language of the podcast (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'pt').

link.description: URL of the podcast's homepage or companion website.

movedTo.description: AT URI of the new canonical podcast record after an ownership transfer. When set, consumers should follow this reference to the current record.
